sloka: स तं राजा समारुह्य कामगं वीर्यनिर्जितम् ।जितं त्रिभुवनं मेने दर्पोत्सेकात्सुदुर्मतिः ।। ७.१५.४३ ॥
transliteration: sa taṁ rājā samāruhya kāmagaṁ vīryanirjitam ।jitaṁ tribhuvanaṁ mene darpotsekātsudurmatiḥ ।। 7.15.43 ॥

translations.english: Having ascended that wish-fulfilling vehicle, which he had conquered by his prowess, the very foolish King Ravana, swollen with excessive pride, believed he had conquered the three worlds.
